versos.grego: Μετὰ δὲ ταῦτα ἀνέδειξεν ὁ Κύριος ἑτέρους ἑβδομήκοντα, καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς ἀνὰ δύο πρὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ εἰς πᾶσαν πόλιν καὶ τόπον οὗ ἤμελλεν αὐτὸς ἔρχεσθαι.

controles.web: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place, where he was about to come.
controles.kjv: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.
controles.livre: E depois disso, o Senhor ordenou ainda outros setenta, e os mandou de dois em dois adiante de sua face, para toda cidade e lugar aonde ele havia de vir.

versos.grego: ἔλεγεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς Ὁ μὲν θερισμὸς πολύς, οἱ δὲ ἐργάται ὀλίγοι· δεήθητε οὖν τοῦ Κυρίου τοῦ θερισμοῦ ὅπως ἐργάτας ἐκβάλῃ εἰς τὸν θερισμὸν αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.
controles.kjv: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.
controles.livre: E lhes dizia: “A colheita verdadeiramente é grande, mas os trabalhadores são poucos; portanto rogai ao Senhor da colheita para que ele envie trabalhadores para a sua colheita.

versos.grego: ὑπάγετε· ἰδοὺ ἀποστέλλω ὑμᾶς ὡς ἄρνας ἐν μέσῳ λύκων.

controles.web: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.
controles.kjv: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.
controles.livre: Ide; eis que eu vos mando como cordeiros no meio dos lobos.

versos.grego: μὴ βαστάζετε βαλλάντιον, μὴ πήραν, μὴ ὑποδήματα· καὶ μηδένα κατὰ τὴν ὁδὸν ἀσπάσησθε.

controles.web: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.
controles.kjv: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.
controles.livre: Não leveis bolsa, nem sacola, nem sandálias; e a ninguém saudeis pelo caminho.

versos.grego: εἰς ἣν δ’ ἂν εἰσέλθητε οἰκίαν, πρῶτον λέγετε Εἰρήνη τῷ οἴκῳ τούτῳ.

controles.web: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’
controles.kjv: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.
controles.livre: E em qualquer casa que entrardes, dizei primeiro: Paz seja nesta casa.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐὰν ἐκεῖ ᾖ υἱὸς εἰρήνης, ἐπαναπαήσεται ἐπ’ αὐτὸν ἡ εἰρήνη ὑμῶν· εἰ δὲ μήγε, ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς ἀνακάμψει.

controles.web: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.
controles.kjv: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.
controles.livre: E se ali houver algum filho da paz, a vossa paz repousará sobre ele; e se não, ela voltará para vós mesmos.

versos.grego: ἐν αὐτῇ δὲ τῇ οἰκίᾳ μένετε, ἔσθοντες καὶ πίνοντες τὰ παρ’ αὐτῶν· ἄξιος γὰρ ὁ ἐργάτης τοῦ μισθοῦ αὐτοῦ. μὴ μεταβαίνετε ἐξ οἰκίας εἰς οἰκίαν.

controles.web: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go from house to house.
controles.kjv: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.
controles.livre: E ficai na mesma casa, comendo e bebendo do que eles vos derem; pois o trabalhador é digno do seu salário. Não vos mudeis de casa em casa.

versos.grego: καὶ εἰς ἣν ἂν πόλιν εἰσέρχησθε καὶ δέχωνται ὑμᾶς, ἐσθίετε τὰ παρατιθέμενα ὑμῖν,

controles.web: Into whatever city you enter, and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.
controles.kjv: And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:
controles.livre: E em qualquer cidade que entrardes, e vos receberem, comei do que puserem diante de vós.

versos.grego: καὶ θεραπεύετε τοὺς ἐν αὐτῇ ἀσθενεῖς, καὶ λέγετε αὐτοῖς Ἤγγικεν ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: Heal the sick who are therein, and tell them, ‘The Kingdom of God has come near to you.’
controles.kjv: And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
controles.livre: E curai os enfermos que nela houver, e dizei-lhes: Chegado é para vós o reino de Deus.

versos.grego: εἰς ἣν δ’ ἂν πόλιν εἰσέλθητε καὶ μὴ δέχωνται ὑμᾶς, ἐξελθόντες εἰς τὰς πλατείας αὐτῆς εἴπατε

controles.web: But into whatever city you enter, and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,
controles.kjv: But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,
controles.livre: Mas em qualquer cidade em que entrardes e não vos receberem, saí pelas ruas, e dizei:

versos.grego: Καὶ τὸν κονιορτὸν τὸν κολληθέντα ἡμῖν ἐκ τῆς πόλεως ὑμῶν εἰς τοὺς πόδας ἀπομασσόμεθα ὑμῖν· πλὴν τοῦτο γινώσκετε, ὅτι ἤγγικεν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: ‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that the Kingdom of God has come near to you.’
controles.kjv: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.
controles.livre: Até o pó da vossa cidade que ficou em nós, sacudimos sobre vós; porém disto sabeis, que o reino de Deus é chegado até vós.

versos.grego: λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι Σοδόμοις ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἀνεκτότερον ἔσται ἢ τῇ πόλει ἐκείνῃ.

controles.web: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.
controles.kjv: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.
controles.livre: E eu vos digo, que mais tolerável será naquele dia para Sodoma, do que para aquela cidade.

versos.grego: Οὐαί σοι, Χοραζείν, οὐαί σοι, Βηθσαϊδά· ὅτι εἰ ἐν Τύρῳ καὶ Σιδῶνι ἐγενήθησαν αἱ δυνάμεις αἱ γενόμεναι ἐν ὑμῖν, πάλαι ἂν ἐν σάκκῳ καὶ σποδῷ καθήμενοι μετενόησαν.

controles.web: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
controles.kjv: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
controles.livre: Ai de ti, Corazim! Ai de ti, Betsaida! Porque se em Tiro e em Sidom tivessem sido feitas as maravilhas que foram feitas entre vós, há muito tempo que teriam se arrependido em saco e em cinza.

versos.grego: πλὴν Τύρῳ καὶ Σιδῶνι ἀνεκτότερον ἔσται ἐν τῇ κρίσει ἢ ὑμῖν.

controles.web: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.
controles.kjv: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.
controles.livre: Portanto, para Tiro e Sidom será mais tolerável no juízo, do que para vós.

versos.grego: καὶ σύ, Καφαρναούμ, μὴ ἕως οὐρανοῦ ὑψωθήσῃ; ἕως τοῦ Ἅιδου καταβήσῃ.

controles.web: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.
controles.kjv: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.
controles.livre: E tu, Cafarnaum, que pensas  estar elevada ao céu, até o mundo dos mortos serás derrubada!

versos.grego: Ὁ ἀκούων ὑμῶν ἐμοῦ ἀκούει, καὶ ὁ ἀθετῶν ὑμᾶς ἐμὲ ἀθετεῖ· ὁ δὲ ἐμὲ ἀθετῶν ἀθετεῖ τὸν ἀποστείλαντά με.

controles.web: Whoever listens to you listens to me, and whoever rejects you rejects me. Whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.”
controles.kjv: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me.
controles.livre: Quem vos ouve, ouve a mim; e quem vos rejeita, rejeita a mim; e quem me rejeita, rejeita aquele que me enviou.

versos.grego: Ὑπέστρεψαν δὲ οἱ ἑβδομήκοντα μετὰ χαρᾶς λέγοντες Κύριε, καὶ τὰ δαιμόνια ὑποτάσσεται ἡμῖν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου.

controles.web: The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”
controles.kjv: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.
controles.livre: E os setenta voltaram com alegria, dizendo: Senhor, até os demônios se sujeitam a nós por teu nome.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς Ἐθεώρουν τὸν Σατανᾶν ὡς ἀστραπὴν ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ πεσόντα.

controles.web: He said to them, “I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.
controles.livre: E disse-lhes: Eu vi a Satanás, que caía do céu como um raio.

versos.grego: ἰδοὺ δέδωκα ὑμῖν τὴν ἐξουσίαν τοῦ πατεῖν ἐπάνω ὄφεων καὶ σκορπίων, καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν δύναμιν τοῦ ἐχθροῦ, καὶ οὐδὲν ὑμᾶς οὐ μὴ ἀδικήσει.

controles.web: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.
controles.kjv: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.
controles.livre: Eis que vos dou poder para pisar sobre serpentes e escorpiões, e sobre toda a força do inimigo, e nada vos fará dano nenhum.

versos.grego: πλὴν ἐν τούτῳ μὴ χαίρετε ὅτι τὰ πνεύματα ὑμῖν ὑποτάσσεται, χαίρετε δὲ ὅτι τὰ ὀνόματα ὑμῶν ἐνγέγραπται ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς.

controles.web: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”
controles.kjv: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.
controles.livre: Mas não vos alegreis de que os espíritos se sujeitem a vós; em vez disso, alegrai-vos por vossos nomes estarem escritos nos céus.

versos.grego: Ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἠγαλλιάσατο τῷ Πνεύματι τῷ Ἁγίῳ καὶ εἶπεν Ἐξομολογοῦμαί σοι, Πάτερ, Κύριε τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ τῆς γῆς, ὅτι ἀπέκρυψας ταῦτα ἀπὸ σοφῶν καὶ συνετῶν, καὶ ἀπεκάλυψας αὐτὰ νηπίοις· ναί, ὁ Πατήρ, ὅτι οὕτως εὐδοκία ἐγένετο ἔμπροσθέν σου.

controles.web: In that same hour Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.”
controles.kjv: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.
controles.livre: Naquela hora Jesus se alegrou em espírito, e disse: Graças te dou, o Pai, Senhor do céu e da terra; porque tu escondeste estas coisas aos sábios e instruídos, e as revelaste às crianças. Sim, Pai, porque assim lhe agradou diante de ti.

versos.grego: πάντα μοι παρεδόθη ὑπὸ τοῦ Πατρός μου, καὶ οὐδεὶς γινώσκει τίς ἐστιν ὁ Υἱὸς εἰ μὴ ὁ Πατήρ, καὶ τίς ἐστιν ὁ Πατὴρ εἰ μὴ ὁ Υἱὸς καὶ ᾧ ἐὰν βούληται ὁ Υἱὸς ἀποκαλύψαι.

controles.web: Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.”
controles.kjv: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.
controles.livre: Todas as coisas me foram entregues pelo meu Pai; e ninguém sabe quem é o Filho, a não ser o Pai; nem quem é o Pai, a não ser o Filho, e a quem o Filho o quiser revelar.

versos.grego: Καὶ στραφεὶς πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς κατ’ ἰδίαν εἶπεν Μακάριοι οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ οἱ βλέποντες ἃ βλέπετε.

controles.web: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,
controles.kjv: And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:
controles.livre: E virando-se para seus discípulos, disse -lhes à parte: Bem-aventurados os olhos que veem o que vós vedes.

versos.grego: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι πολλοὶ προφῆται καὶ βασιλεῖς ἠθέλησαν ἰδεῖν ἃ ὑμεῖς βλέπετε καὶ οὐκ εἶδαν, καὶ ἀκοῦσαι ἃ ἀκούετε καὶ οὐκ ἤκουσαν.

controles.web: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.”
controles.kjv: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
controles.livre: Porque vos digo, que muitos profetas e reis desejaram ver o que vós vedes, e não o viram; o ouvir o que vós ouvis, e não o ouviram.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἰδοὺ νομικός τις ἀνέστη ἐκπειράζων αὐτὸν λέγων Διδάσκαλε, τί ποιήσας ζωὴν αἰώνιον κληρονομήσω;

controles.web: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”
controles.kjv: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?
controles.livre: E eis que um certo estudioso da Lei se levantou, tentando-o, e dizendo: Mestre, o que devo fazer para ter para herdar a vida eterna?

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν Ἐν τῷ νόμῳ τί γέγραπται; πῶς ἀναγινώσκεις;

controles.web: He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”
controles.kjv: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?
controles.livre: E ele lhe disse: O que está escrito na Lei? Como tu a lês?

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Ἀγαπήσεις Κύριον τὸν Θεόν σου ἐξ ὅλης τῆς καρδίας σου καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ ψυχῇ σου καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ ἰσχύϊ σου καὶ ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ διανοίᾳ σου, καὶ τὸν πλησίον σου ὡς σεαυτόν.

controles.web: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.”
controles.kjv: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.
controles.livre: E respondendo ele, disse: Amarás ao Senhor teu Deus de todo teu coração, e de toda tua alma, e de todas tuas forças, e de todo teu entendimento; e amarás a teu próximo como a ti mesmo.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ Ὀρθῶς ἀπεκρίθης· τοῦτο ποίει καὶ ζήσῃ.

controles.web: He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.
controles.livre: E disse-lhe: Respondeste bem; faze isso, e viverás.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ θέλων δικαιῶσαι ἑαυτὸν εἶπεν πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν Καὶ τίς ἐστίν μου πλησίον;

controles.web: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”
controles.kjv: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour?
controles.livre: Mas ele, querendo se justificar, disse a Jesus: E quem é o meu próximo?

versos.grego: ὑπολαβὼν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Ἄνθρωπός τις κατέβαινεν ἀπὸ Ἱερουσαλὴμ εἰς Ἱερειχώ, καὶ λῃσταῖς περιέπεσεν, οἳ καὶ ἐκδύσαντες αὐτὸν καὶ πληγὰς ἐπιθέντες ἀπῆλθον ἀφέντες ἡμιθανῆ.

controles.web: Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
controles.kjv: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
controles.livre: E respondendo Jesus, disse: Um homem descia de Jerusalém a Jericó, e foi atacado por assaltantes, que também tiraram suas roupas, espancaram-no, e se foram, deixando-o meio morto.

versos.grego: κατὰ συγκυρίαν δὲ ἱερεύς τις κατέβαινεν ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ἐκείνῃ, καὶ ἰδὼν αὐτὸν ἀντιπαρῆλθεν.

controles.web: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
controles.kjv: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
controles.livre: E por acaso descia um certo sacerdote pelo mesmo caminho, e vendo -o ,passou longe dele .

versos.grego: ὁμοίως δὲ καὶ Λευείτης κατὰ τὸν τόπον ἐλθὼν καὶ ἰδὼν ἀντιπαρῆλθεν.

controles.web: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place, and saw him, passed by on the other side.
controles.kjv: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side.
controles.livre: E semelhantemente também um levita, chegando junto a aquele lugar, veio, e vendo -o ,passou longe dele

versos.grego: Σαμαρείτης δέ τις ὁδεύων ἦλθεν κατ’ αὐτὸν καὶ ἰδὼν ἐσπλαγχνίσθη,

controles.web: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,
controles.kjv: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,
controles.livre: Porém um certo samaritano, que ia pelo caminho, veio junto a ele, e vendo-o, teve compaixão dele .

versos.grego: καὶ προσελθὼν κατέδησεν τὰ τραύματα αὐτοῦ ἐπιχέων ἔλαιον καὶ οἶνον, ἐπιβιβάσας δὲ αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸ ἴδιον κτῆνος ἤγαγεν αὐτὸν εἰς πανδοχεῖον καὶ ἐπεμελήθη αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
controles.kjv: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
controles.livre: E chegando-se, amarrou-lhe um curativo nas feridas, pondo-lhe nelas azeite e vinho; e pondo-o sobre o animal que o transportava, levou-o para uma hospedaria, e cuidou dele.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν αὔριον ἐκβαλὼν δύο δηνάρια ἔδωκεν τῷ πανδοχεῖ καὶ εἶπεν Ἐπιμελήθητι αὐτοῦ, καὶ ὅ τι ἂν προσδαπανήσῃς ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ ἐπανέρχεσθαί με ἀποδώσω σοι.

controles.web: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, and gave them to the host, and said to him, ‘Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.’
controles.kjv: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.
controles.livre: E partindo-se no outro dia, tirou dois dinheiros, e os deu para o hospedeiro; e disse-lhe: Cuide dele; e tudo o que gastares a mais, eu te pagarei quando voltar.

versos.grego: τίς τούτων τῶν τριῶν πλησίον δοκεῖ σοι γεγονέναι τοῦ ἐμπεσόντος εἰς τοὺς λῃστάς;

controles.web: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”
controles.kjv: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?
controles.livre: Quem, pois, destes três te parece que foi o próximo daquele que foi atacado por assaltantes?

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Ὁ ποιήσας τὸ ἔλεος μετ’ αὐτοῦ. εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Πορεύου καὶ σὺ ποίει ὁμοίως.

controles.web: He said, “He who showed mercy on him.”   Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”
controles.kjv: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.
controles.livre: Ele disse: Aquele que agiu tendo misericórdia com ele.Então Jesus lhe disse: Vai, e faze da mesma maneira.

versos.grego: Ἐν δὲ τῷ πορεύεσθαι αὐτοὺς αὐτὸς εἰσῆλθεν εἰς κώμην τινά· γυνὴ δέ τις ὀνόματι Μάρθα ὑπεδέξατο αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν.

controles.web: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
controles.kjv: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que eles, enquanto eles caminhavam, ele entrou em uma aldeia; e uma certa mulher, de nome Marta, o recebeu em sua casa.

versos.grego: καὶ τῇδε ἦν ἀδελφὴ καλουμένη Μαριάμ, ἣ καὶ παρακαθεσθεῖσα πρὸς τοὺς πόδας τοῦ Κυρίου ἤκουεν τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet, and heard his word.
controles.kjv: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus’ feet, and heard his word.
controles.livre: E esta tinha uma irmã, chamada Maria, a qual, sentando-se também aos pés de Jesus, ouvia sua palavra.

versos.grego: ἡ δὲ Μάρθα περιεσπᾶτο περὶ πολλὴν διακονίαν· ἐπιστᾶσα δὲ εἶπεν Κύριε, οὐ μέλει σοι ὅτι ἡ ἀδελφή μου μόνην με κατέλειπεν διακονεῖν; εἰπὸν οὖν αὐτῇ ἵνα μοι συναντιλάβηται.

controles.web: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, “Lord, don’t you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me.”
controles.kjv: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.
controles.livre: Marta, porém, ficava muito ocupada com muitos serviços; e ela, vindo, disse: Senhor, não te importas que minha irmã me deixe sozinha para servir? Dize a ela, pois, que me ajude.

versos.grego: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῇ ὁ Κύριος Μάρθα Μάρθα, μεριμνᾷς καὶ θορυβάζῃ περὶ πολλά,

controles.web: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,
controles.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:
controles.livre: E respondendo Jesus, disse-lhe: Marta, Marta, tu és preocupada com muitas coisas, e perturbada por elas;

versos.grego: ὀλίγων δέ ἐστιν χρεία ἢ ἑνός· Μαριὰμ γὰρ τὴν ἀγαθὴν μερίδα ἐξελέξατο, ἥτις οὐκ ἀφαιρεθήσεται αὐτῆς.

controles.web: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”
controles.kjv: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
controles.livre: Mas somente uma coisa é necessária. E Maria escolheu a parte boa, a qual não lhe será tirada.
